notes: "So what did I build? While looking at how people are teaching agents to make slides, I met the PPTD idea in the Kimi Slides ecosystem: a deck kept as a folder of page files rather than one packed file. Then I found OpenSlide, an open-source editor where every page is a React component. I thought these two ideas fit together: PPTD as the document, React as the interface. HUANDENG is that combination, packaged as an Electron desktop app. Most of the editing behaviour comes from OpenSlide; sections, views and notes borrow from PowerPoint and WPS, and the Layers panel takes its cue from Photoshop. Next to the editor sits a plugin, so that the AI client you already use can work in the same editor. Editor plus plugin is the workflow. To be precise about credit: OpenPPTD is a different project, and we reuse only its equation-conversion code. And HUANDENG has no affiliation with Kimi."
